sources.snippet: A voxel pagoda garden, 1 shot prompt running on an RTX 5070 with Strata (IQ3_S, 128K context) · full video (49 s) Strata runs Qwen3.8-Flash-Next - a large, smart AI model that normally needs a server - on a normal PC. It chats, writes code, reads pictures and works with your apps and coding agents, and nothing leaves your PC.
